about: CLARINET's instrument voice (pp_bridge.voice) against the kit: each note from the shared noise state the one before left (the first from a fresh default_rng(77)); per note its length, its peak (float.hex()) and the RMS of every 10 ms block (rounded to 1e-9; the bar is 1e-6), the noise state after it and the SHA-256 of its float64 samples; the notes themselves are in the cache
